caption:
Prices jumped again last month 📈

The September CPI report shows inflation at 3.7% over the past year, up from 3.4% in August.
The big driver? Gasoline, up 9.1% in one month.

The good news: food prices were flat for the month.

Did you feel the gas jump at the pump?
first_comment: Be honest: what did you notice getting more expensive this month? 👇
